patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with a dark video background and left-aligned text overlay, setting a sophisticated tone.
Elegant, large serif display font for primary headings, contrasted with a clean, highly readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
Predominantly dark theme using a very dark grey background with high-contrast white text, creating a luxurious and serious aesthetic.

The hero background image/video exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content. The main navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking slightly and gaining a solid dark background.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections, often separated by significant vertical spacing and sometimes using alternating background shades (dark grey to slightly lighter dark grey).

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that reduces in height and changes its background from transparent to a solid dark color upon scrolling. The hero section utilizes a video or large image background that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect. Content sections further down the page are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely a combination of fade-up and slide-in effects, orchestrated with CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.

Achieve a sophisticated dark mode aesthetic by using a very dark grey as the primary background color, paired with pure white text for maximum contrast and readability. Hero images or videos are overlaid with a dark, subtle gradient to ensure text legibility without obscuring the background details entirely.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings with generous line height (~3-4x body) are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, particularly in the hero and between major sections, with a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated and luxurious dark aesthetic, achieved through a dominant dark grey palette, elegant serif typography for headings, and subtle parallax motion in the hero. It avoids common bright, airy SaaS designs for a more authoritative and high-end feel.
